description: Shows where one game stands (read-only, needs login): listing status (draft, live, unlisted, banned), the live version, requested vs live permissions, the latest version's state, its server autotest report, the reviewer's reject reasons with how to fix each, and the previous versions' states. Use it after uploading or submitting, and to read a rejection. texts:true instead returns the listing text of every supported locale with its status (developer-written, machine-translated, missing), the source text to translate from and the field limits.

game.description: Game slug or id, from gamealia_list_games (a game of the active account)

texts.description: Include the per-locale listing texts, their status and the limits

name: gamealia_get_status
title: Game and version status
